subject: Autonomy at Eacon <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

I lead GTM efforts for Physical AI at Encord
<[LINK]>
where we partner with some of the fastest growing companies across ADAS/AV,
robotics, drones, and space.

our platform handles multi-cam video, 3D point, and telemetry data in the

good day to do so and I'll share an invite for us to connect.

subject: Long-Horizon Physical AI Summit in SF - Oct 20&21

text:
